summary: Z Squared Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its acquisition by Coeptis Therapeutics Holdings, Inc. via a reverse merger: Coeptis’s subsidiary CP Merger Sub merged into Z Squared, with Z Squared surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary, now renamed Z Squared OpCo Inc. Coeptis then renamed itself to Z Squared Inc. (Pubco), with Z Squared becoming the public entity. Exact terms (price, premium, stake) are not disclosed in this excerpt. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing covers completion of acquisition, changes in control, director departures, and charter amendments. Watch for post-merger financial statements and integration execution.
